title: Reflective document.write and HTML-property mutations bypassed markup sink checks

reproduction.beforeFix: The reflective document.write, innerHTML, and outerHTML sinks returned pass.
reproduction.afterFix: Reflective markup writers and HTML property assignments fail the source-isolation gate.

rootCause: Markup protection checked direct document.write/writeln calls and source-text innerHTML patterns, but did not resolve Reflect.apply, Reflect.set, or descriptor-based mutations.
remediation: Resolve aliases to document markup writers and statically named reflective DOM sinks in the TypeScript AST, without executing resource source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "reflective DOM markup injection sinks"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: reflective writes returned pass
validation.runtimeBoundary: Sandboxed preview and deployed CSP checks remain independent controls.
